description: A token's address, decimals and price in USD. By symbol ("USDC"): the well-known tokens of our lists, on the network given or on every network that has one. By contract address with chainId: any token, read from the chain when our lists do not have it and then marked verified: false. Anyone can make a token with any symbol, so trade by address and run check_token on an unverified one. No API key needed.

chainId.description: The network, a chainId from get_networks; required with an address, optional with a symbol

query.description: The token's symbol (USDC, WETH) or its contract address

name: find_token
title: Find a token
